name: gear-monster-horns-wisp
prompt: The reference image shows a small creature; use it ONLY to judge the width of its head. Do NOT draw the creature or any part of it — the image must contain nothing but two horns. Draw a pair of small cute monster horns: exactly TWO stubby soft cone horns with rounded tips, curving slightly outward away from each other, mirror images, positioned with an empty gap between them sized so they would sit on the outer edges of the reference creature's crown (a narrow flame crown — horns close together). NO headband, NO arc, NO connector, nothing joining them. Sticker-flat cel style, every region ONE perfectly even solid color like a vector illustration — no shading variation, no wash, no mottling — one thick confident uniform rounded outline in a darker shade of each part's own color, never black. Colors limited to exactly two: warm cocoa brown (#7a5b43) for the horns, soft warm cream (#f2e9d3) for the rounded tips. Cute and friendly, never scary. The pair centered, 10% margin, on a plain solid magenta (#ff00ff) background, no shadow. Negative constraints: no headband, no band, no arc, no connector, no third horn, no narrow gap, no gray, no gradients, no texture, no stipple, no halftone, no watercolor, no 3d render, no clay, no sharp points, no scary look, no cast shadow, no drop shadow, no background scenery, no character, no head, no face, no outline sketchiness, no black outline, no text, no watermark, no sticker border, no die-cut white edge.
